text: 时代新材公告，2026年上半年营业收入104.67亿元，同比增长13.09%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润3.46亿元，同比增长14.08%；归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润3.12亿元，同比增长33.91%。上年同期净利润3.03亿元。公司拟向全体股东每10股派发现金股利人民币0.90元（含税）。
text_en: Times New Material announced H1 2026 revenue of 10.467 billion yuan, up 13.09% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 346 million yuan, up 14.08%; non-GAAP net profit was 312 million yuan, up 33.91%. Prior-year net profit was 303 million yuan. The company plans a cash dividend of 0.90 yuan per 10 shares (tax included).
